versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g If • NmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE • and a transmission of a PNC bit vector is indicated via Nm_PncBitVec- torTxIndication (<NM-channel>, <buffer to provide the unfiltered PNC bit vector of aggregated internal PNC requests >) • and PNCs are requested within the stored unfiltered PNC bit vector (bits set to 1) • and the requested PNCs of the stored unfiltered PNC bit vector for internal PNC requests are set to 1 within the configured PN filter mask then Nm shall store the request information (value 1) for these PNCs as "PNC re- quested".
